## Overview

The Media Viewer includes a vertical toolbar on the left edge of the canvas (to the left of the pixel ruler). Tools are shown as square icon buttons; one tool is selected at a time.

## Select Tool

The pointer (mouse) icon is the **Select** tool. It is selected by default. Canvas interaction for this tool is not wired yet; it is a placeholder for future selection behavior.
